concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 requires reporting a 95 % confidence interval for ΔR², but no task generates or records this confidence interval (e.g., no task creates a JSON or CSV with CI bounds).

Success Criterion SC-002 defines significance as the observed coefficient falling outside the percentile range of the null distribution, yet no task explicitly verifies or records this percentile‑range check; existing permutation tasks only output p‑values.

Success Criterion SC-003 calls for measuring stability of significance findings across thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.10}, but no task produces an artifact that reports how the number of significant predictors varies with each threshold (e.g., a summary table or plot).
